aws_exempt_rule: Require-Consultant.md §2 standing rule, 'the one AWS-only carve-out'. Scope: the reused CDSecLab/Doris container, structural quantities only. Our own Rust structural metrics are not covered and run on AWS.

provenance.note: Structural metrics only. No wall-clock figure is produced or permitted from this baseline: plan §5 restricts a Python implementation to language-independent axes.

determinism.compared: every row field except canonical_bytes_added, setup_attempts, zr_short_encodings
determinism.excluded_reason: setup_attempts counts retries of upstream's probabilistic TSet setup and is a property of the run, not of the index. It is recorded per run below.

rows.comm_note: not measured: upstream's cal_comm_cost is len(pickle.dumps(...)), which is Python serialization overhead rather than a wire-format byte count, so it is not comparable across languages (plan section 5)
